recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is recommended for FHIR-7932 unless the work group separately wants to revisit the generic consistency requirement for returned ETag values.
issue_request: FHIR-7932 was Published/Persuasive for the DSTU1 RESTful API page and requested changing the Conformance resource ETag requirement from SHALL to SHOULD because ETag support was not mandatory for other resources and should not require special handling for Conformance.
initial_application: Jira comments record svn revision #5342. Git-svn commit faf642834768d4564aa59e6488b2750d0ee74351 (#7932 - change conformance from SHALL to SHOULD) changed source/http.html from an ETag SHALL requirement to SHOULD for the Conformance response while retaining the value-consistency rule when an ETag is returned.
additional_context: The old Conformance resource was later renamed to CapabilityStatement and the interaction is now the capabilities interaction. Applied/Persuasive FHIR-40496 and commit 08e2ca9544ccdc4e19a042aa50bc35239a927da0 later clarified the same capabilities section while preserving the ETag SHOULD wording and the returned-resource consistency rule. Exact Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/http.html says an ETag header SHOULD be returned with the capabilities response, which satisfies the optional-support request. The remaining SHALL requires the value to change if a returned ETag is used and the returned resource changes; it does not make ETag support mandatory.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied/Persuasive capabilities clarification retained the ETag SHOULD wording and separated nearby fhirVersion and 404 text; it was context only and not independently decided here.
